thread:
maria.devex: Running into flakey SSL/proxy behavior with the Python SDK against Dedicated endpoints. Sometimes the request never completes, sometimes it errors with ssl.SSLCertVerificationError.
ryan.eng-runtime: Can you share a minimal async repro? sync vs async matters because we wire aiohttp differently.
maria.devex: Minimal repro (async):
```python
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient

os.environ['HTTPS_PROXY'] = 'http://corp-proxy:3128'
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'], base_url='https://dedicated.acme.internal', verify='/opt/certs/corp-ca.pem')
await client.chat.create(model='redwood-1', messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
```
If HTTPS_PROXY is unset it works. If set, sometimes it stalls for ~20-30s then raises certificate verify failed.
jamal.sre: sounds like proxy TLS interception + client not loading the provided CA correctly for aiohttp. Do we normalize verify param in async client?
alex.devex: I hit a related bug: passing verify as a directory (capath) works in requests but not in our async path. We should accept cafile or capath consistently.
ryan.eng-runtime: Actionable items I see: 1) normalize `verify` to an SSLContext in a helper used by both sync/async; 2) make proxy env handling configurable per deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated); 3) better error messages and timeouts for proxy TLS handshake.
maria.devex: Agreed. For (2) current transport disables trust_env globally which is fine for hosted but breaks Dedicated customers behind corp proxies. We should have transport option `trust_env_proxies` and default it based on base_url pattern or an explicit client kwarg.
jamal.sre: Also we should document NO_PROXY recommendations in Dedicated onboarding. If control plane is private, customers often need NO_PROXY for internal hosts.
ryan.eng-runtime: I'll draft a PR: - add _normalize_ssl_verify(verify) returning bool or ssl.SSLContext - make aiohttp.ClientSession use that SSLContext when provided - add transport factory arg trust_env_proxies(default=None) -> infer from base_url if None - improve logging: distinct messages for ProxyHandshakeTimeout vs CertVerificationFailed
alex.devex: Suggest adding a unit test matrix for: (verify as cafile, verify as capath, verify as None) x (HTTPS_PROXY set, not set) and an integration test using mitmproxy container in CI to reproduce interception.
ci-bot: created pipeline for branch rryan/normalize-ssl-verify  build queued.
maria.devex: I'll assemble a tiny docker-compose with mitmproxy + server cert signed by corp CA to validate. Will post gist.
ryan.eng-runtime: Thanks. I'll include a small snippet in PR docs showing how to set verify and trust_env_proxies for Dedicated:
```python
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., base_url='https://dedicated.acme.internal', verify='/opt/certs/corp-ca.pem', trust_env_proxies=True)
```
jamal.sre: One more nit: ensure the sync requests path still respects REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and SSL_CERT_FILE envvars if provided. Keep behavior consistent.
maria.devex: +1. Acceptance: async+sync parity for cafile/capath, proxy env toggle for dedicated/private, clearer errors, CI mitmproxy test.
ryan.eng-runtime: Opening the issue and assigning to myself. Will link PR here when ready.
